newsitem.title: LATVIA: Kaija trade soars on active Latvia bourse.
newsitem.headline: Kaija trade soars on active Latvia bourse.

text.p: Fish cannery Kaija saw bumper trade of 101,079 lats on the Latvian bourse on Wednesday as most prices on the market rose and overall activity was buoyant.
Trade came to 427,632 lats, around twice yesterday's volume, and Kaija rose to 2.25 lats from 1.96 on the secondary list.
On the primary market, Unibanka turned over 50,960 lats as it slipped higher to 3.25 lats from 3.22 lats and Riga Transport Fleet added 20 santimes to 1.58 lats on turnover of 42,010 lats.
Staburadze increased to 2.70 from 2.69 lats on activity of 44,598 lats.
Other shares on the secondary list also saw healthy trade.
Lode turned over 75,948 lats and rose to 2.05 lats from 1.79 and Daugavpils Chain traded 59,373 lats as it rose to 2.48 lats from 2.16 lats.
Other active stocks included the Salacgriva fish cannery on 11,162 lats, rising to 4.70 lats from 4.09 lats and Rigas Raugs yeast factory on 17,646 lats as it climbed to 4.16 lats from 3.62 lats.
The Roja fish cannery traded 9,045 lats and added 20 santimes to 2.70 lats and Jekabpils Sugar rose to 58 santimes from 55 on 6,984 lats of activity.
